CHINESE NAME 龍惠 W. LOONG
THE BRIDGE HOUSE HOTEL, LIMITED
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / C. B. REGISTRY / No. S. B. D. 24641 / 6. 6. 31.）
TELEGRAPHIC ADDRESS
BRIDGE, NANKING.

Nanking, 5th June 1931.

J. P. Jones Esq.
S. M. P.

Dear Sir

I arrived here this afternoon and immediately
went to the Consulate and found that they had
already been in touch with the Foreign Office and
Police but so far had no news of either my son or
the alleged Russian. I then went with Mr. Lee of
the Consulate to see Capt. Tang of the Police but he
knew nothing either and stated that he did not
think anyone arrested at Lumin or Soochow would
be sent here as they have boats at Soochow high
enough to handle the matter. I therefore sent you a
telegram "no trace either."

I am waiting here until tomorrow and if you
have any further news will be glad if you will wire. If
I get any I will wire you. Yours faithfully
〔此处转录不清〕

中文姓名 龍惠 W. LOONG
THE BRIDGE HOUSE HOTEL, LIMITED
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 中央捕房登记处 / 编号 S. B. D. 24641 / 31年6月6日。）
电报挂号
BRIDGE, NANKING.

南京，1931年6月5日。

J. P. Jones 先生
上海公共租界工部局警务处

尊敬的先生：

我于今日下午抵达此处，并立即
前往领事馆，发现他们已
与外交部及警方取得联系，但迄今
尚未获得关于我儿子或那名所谓俄国人的任何消息。随后，我与领事馆的李先生一同去见警方的唐上尉，但他也
一无所知，并表示他认为在礼查饭店（Lumin）或苏州被捕的人不会被送至此地，因为他们在苏州有足够处理此事的船只。因此，我给您发了一封电报称“均无踪迹”。

我将在此等候至明日，若您有进一步消息，恳请发电告知。若我得到任何消息，亦将电告您。此致
敬礼
〔此处转录不清〕

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. I. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2464.
Date 3 - 6 - 31.

Special Branch,
June 1, 1931.

D. C. (Crime),

Mansel Hay-Thorburn, No. 315 Rue Bourgeat,
reports that his son William John left home about
8.30 p.m. May 31 and has not since returned home.
William John Hay-Thorburn is about 19 years old,
5 ft. 10 in. tall, slim build, brown eyes, scar
on cheek under left eye, brown hair, temperate habits.
His companions include :
Mr. F.A. Olsen, No. 13 Sun Avenue.
Mr. K.M. Pate, employed in Telephone Co.
Bert Andrews, Traffic Department, B.A.T.
Mrs. W.P. Roberts, Flat No. 6, North side of Boonde Road
opposite Pearce Apartments.
The last named saw young Hay-Thorburn on the morning
of June 1 when he gave her a letter to give to his
father. This letter reads as follows :-
"Dear Dad,
I am leaving Shanghai for an indefinite
"period on business and do not know when I will
"get back. I didn't tell you because I know you
"would try to stop me.
"Please tell everyone who enquires that
"I have gone away for a business trip up country.
"Cheerio,
"John".
Since W.J. Hay-Thorburn disappeared, his father has
found that the former's .45 Webley S.V.C. revolver is
missing.

（批：Facs & report to French Police
& Consulate. Circulars made
& Photos Copied.
Rca/）

J. P. Givens
O. i/c Sp. Br.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
中央及特别情报处登记处
编号 S. B. D. 2464.
日期 31-6-3.

特别处，
1931年6月1日。

刑事科副总监，

曼塞尔·海-索恩伯恩（Mansel Hay-Thorburn），住址布尔热亚路（Rue Bourgeat）315号，
报告称其子威廉·约翰（William John）于5月31日晚8时30分左右离家，此后未归。
威廉·约翰·海-索恩伯恩（William John Hay-Thorburn）约19岁，
身高5英尺10英寸，体型瘦削，褐色眼睛，左眼下方脸颊处有疤痕，褐色头发，生活习惯节制。
其交往人员包括：
F.A. 奥尔森（F.A. Olsen）先生，孙尼特路（Sun Avenue）13号。
K.M. 佩特（K.M. Pate）先生，受雇于电话公司。
伯特·安德鲁斯（Bert Andrews），英美烟草公司（B.A.T.）交通部门。
W.P. 罗伯茨（W.P. Roberts）夫人，蓬路（Boonde Road）北侧6号公寓，
对面是皮尔斯公寓（Pearce Apartments）。
最后提到这位女士在6月1日上午见到年轻的海-索恩伯恩，当时他交给她一封信，让她转交给他父亲。该信内容如下：-
“亲爱的爸爸，
我将因公务离开上海一段不确定的
“时期，不知何时能回来。我没有告诉你，因为我知道你
“会试图阻止我。
“请告诉所有询问的人，说我
“去内地出差了。
“再见，
“约翰”。
自W.J. 海-索恩伯恩失踪后，其父发现
前者的一把.45口径韦伯利S.V.C.左轮手枪
不见了。

（批：传真及报告致法国警察
及领事馆。已制作
通缉令并复印照片。
Rca/）

J. P. Givens
特别处处长
